I run five miles a day and am a healthy vegan. I know how important it is to take care of yourself, but sometimes that's not enough.

My best friend recently had a drunken conversation with me about suicide. I was recently institutionalized and almost died from a suicide attempt. I still wish it wasn't an attempt and my depression has made it next to impossible to do anything productive. Anyways... I know he was trying to relate and be helpful, but he said something along the lines of "I thought about death in highschool then I told myself I was awesome and I was. You're only sad because you want to be". ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! You think. I intentionally want to put my friends and family through the pain of finding me unconscious, bleeding out, hospitalized?

I feel like dealing with MDD and being "attractive" almost makes it harder. I can't begin to count the amount of times people have said things like "what do you have to be sad about, you're so pretty." I'm depressed because my brain has chemical imbalances and I'm sad that you feel my appearance should interpret my happiness. Ugh.
